svg.aria-label: A Figma file. Rishi draws a frame, drops in the sky from rishiashar.com and types 'I am an Experience Designer'. Claude joins and finishes the sentence: in Toronto, designing and prototyping ideas using AI and emerging tools. Then Rishi opens the Prototype tab and drags a custom bezier into ease-out-expo.
